an5.16:1.3: The power of faith, the power of energy, the power of mindfulness, the power of concentration, and the power of wisdom.
an5.16:1.5: Among these five powers, the power of wisdom is foremost, the one that holds all in place, the one that unifies them.
an5.16:1.6: Just as the peak is the chief part of a peaked-roof house, the part that that holds all in place, that unifies them,
an5.16:1.7: so among these five powers, the power of wisdom is foremost, the one that holds all in place, the one that unifies them.”
